negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out the cheapest possible collection design and forces a document-parsing + register-diffing pipeline; also means person-level coverage will always be assembled, never authoritative from one source.

negative_findings.description: The legacy MNB decision-search application host alk.mnb.hu (referenced by an indexed URL alk.mnb.hu/bal_menu/hatarozatok/hatarozatok_keresese) failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND) from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a HYPOTHESIS of a retired/renamed host, not a verdict — the current live entry point appears to be www.mnb.hu/felugyelet/engedelyezes-es-intezmenyfelugyeles/hatarozatok-es-vegzesek-keresese. Liveness to be settled by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Old indexed URLs for the MNB decision database are still circulating; a collector hard-coded to alk.mnb.hu would silently collect nothing.

negative_findings.description: A guessed MNB path https://www.mnb.hu/felugyelet/engedelyezes-es-intezmenyfelugyeles/hatarozatok-vegzesek returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: The correct slug is '/hatarozatok-es-vegzesek-keresese'. Recorded as a moved/incorrect path, not a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents the exact correct slug so downstream collectors do not repeat the guess.

negative_findings.description: The BÉT issuer-news page (bet.hu/kib_hirek) was fetched; the returned content showed a search box and chronological listing but no RSS feed, category filter for governance/management changes, or export endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection from BÉT will require HTML scraping of the listing plus title keyword filtering and PDF text extraction; no clean API observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering cost and fragility expectations for what is otherwise the highest-signal A5 source for listed financial issuers.

negative_findings.description: Historical/deleted officer data (törölt tisztségviselők, with from/to dates) is not available in the free e-cégjegyzék tier; it requires the paid OCCSZ channel or a commercial aggregator (OPTEN, Céginfo). Free e-cégjegyzék data is also refreshed only weekly and reportedly conditions free access on personal-data handling consent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tenure reconstruction for HU bank executives has a hard cost and licensing component; no free authoritative historical officer feed was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget and legal review are prerequisites before A5 can produce career-history or churn analytics rather than event spotting.

negative_findings.description: I found no Hungarian-language term for a consolidated, cross-institution 'senior management appointments register' in banking — the concept appears not to exist as a named product; the terminology space is fragmented across 'személyi engedély', 'vezető állású személy engedélyezése', 'cégjegyzésre jogosult', 'vezető tisztségviselő'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary is fragmented by legal regime (Hpt./Mnbtv. vs Ctv. vs Tpt.), each using a different word for overlapping populations of people.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity/role normalisation across the three legal regimes is a mandatory modelling step; naive keyword matching will under- or over-count leadership events.

negative_findings.description: English-language searches for HU fit-and-proper decisions returned mostly law-firm guides (Legal 500, Healy Consultants) and the MNB EN mirror — no English feed of actual named appointment decisions.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection for this cell would capture essentially zero primary events; Hungarian-language collection is mandatory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the run's local-language mandate empirically and warns against staffing this cell with EN-only tooling.

negative_findings.description: No official aggregated feed or register of appointments specific to state-owned financial institutions was found; appointments are scattered across Magyar Közlöny, Hivatalos Értesítő, Cégközlöny, ministry press releases and each entity's own site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Hungarian for a consolidated 'állami vállalati vezetői kinevezések' register returned only media coverage and per-entity pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell cannot rely on one feed; it needs a multi-source join keyed on a maintained entity watchlist, with Cégközlöny as the legal backstop.

negative_findings.description: EKR full procedure documentation is behind economic-operator registration; only the public procedure search and the gazette notice are freely retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public materials describe the 2024 search improvements (CPV, subject, place of performance) but full documentation access is via the registered EKR system.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The richest org-change evidence (scope of work, target operating model, headcount) may be unreachable without an account, so the Közbeszerzési Értesítő/TED notice text must carry most of the signal.

negative_findings.description: The public-service job portal appears to have moved from kozigallas.gov.hu to kozszolgallas.ksz.gov.hu; the legacy domain was referenced only via third-party pages in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced kozszolgallas.ksz.gov.hu as the live portal while third-party sites still cite kozigallas.gov.hu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at the legacy host would silently collect nothing; both hosts should be probed by the deterministic verification pass.

negative_findings.description: The közadatkereső central index is documented (including by an ÁSZ analysis) as having uneven completeness and freshness of the statutory publications it indexes.
negative_findings.result_summary: ÁSZ published a dedicated analysis of the közadatkereső system's role, implying known compliance gaps.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using kozadat.hu as a primary collection surface would under-report; it should be used as a discovery index only, with per-entity crawling for actual data.

negative_findings.description: No specific recent appointment for the Magyar Posta financial-services deputy CEO post was located in this pass, despite Hungarian-language querying.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results surfaced the Magyar Posta management page and PDF plus a CEO dismissal report, but not a financial-services-specific deputy CEO appointment.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Magyar Posta's financial arm is a material payments actor; the gap should be closed by diffing the dated 'A Társaság vezetői' PDF series rather than by press search.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language or English evidence surfaced of a Temenos, Backbase or Finastra implementation at OTP, Erste or MBH, despite these being the cell's named seed vendors.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only vendor-vs-vendor comparison marketing. The HU core/digital stack that did surface is different: Oracle Flexcube (MKB/MBH), Intellect iGCB (OTP core revamp), Tietoevry (OTP card acquiring), valantic (Erste instant payments), Finshape/BSC-W.UP (digital channels).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's seed vendor list is partly wrong for Hungary. Monitoring effort should be reallocated to the vendors actually present, or the pointer value of Temenos/Backbase/Finastra pages will be near zero.

negative_findings.description: No Hungary country-manager or country-lead appointment announcement located for Diebold Nixdorf or NCR Atleos.
negative_findings.result_summary: Trade coverage exists for Austria, Portugal and Greece bank deals and for the NCR split into Atleos/Voyix, but nothing HU-specific. Neither vendor appears to run a Hungarian-language newsroom.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ATM-vendor leg of this cell has no self-published channel in Hungary; leadership moves there will have to be caught via the company registry (nemzeticegtar) and manual LinkedIn review rather than press.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of Docler Holding acting as a supplier to Hungarian banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Docler is confirmed as a Luxembourg-headquartered IT/media group with Budapest offices, but nothing connects it to banking or payments delivery. Likewise no ANY Biztonsági Nyomda <-> Nexi Hungary relationship surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Docler should be dropped from this cell's actor map to avoid noise; ANY stays but on card personalisation and transactional print grounds only.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian query terms 'kinevezés' and 'vezető' are heavily polluted by unrelated public-administration and MNB regulatory content.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 4iG appointment query returned MNB decrees, njt.hu legislation and generic AML compliance-officer articles alongside the intended hits.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Production queries must bind the appointment term to a named vendor entity ('4iG' AND 'kinevezés') or add site: constraints; free-floating HU appointment terms will flood the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn is the highest-signal channel for vendor Hungary-lead appointments but is auth-walled and ToS-restricted.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nexi Hungary and other vendor HU pages are indexed and discoverable, but content is not retrievable without login and automated collection is prohibited.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single best signal for this cell's core topic cannot be automated; the run must budget analyst time for manual review or accept a lag via registry-diffing instead.

negative_findings.description: Several vendor root URLs in this slice were inferred from entity names rather than followed link-by-link.
negative_findings.result_summary: cardnet.hu, any.hu, finshape.com, valantic.com and 4ig.hu/hu/sajtoszoba were not individually fetched in this pass; the 4iG domain is confirmed via a 4ig.hu PDF that appeared in results, the others are high-confidence but unfetched.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass must resolve these before they are treated as verified; a 404 on a press-room path should trigger a site-root re-crawl rather than a dead-source verdict.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian event branded 'Budapest Banking Summit' was found. English seed-query searching returned only unrelated Budapest summits (Demographic Summit, Solarplaza, CEE Summit) and MNB's Renminbi Initiative conference.
negative_findings.result_summary: The banking-summit role in Hungary is filled by Portfolio's conference series and FinTechZone's TechShow family, not by an event of that name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents wasted verification effort and mis-scoped collectors; the seed query term should be retired in favour of the real event brands.

negative_findings.description: The Év Bankja site exposes jury pages under year-specific URLs, but only older editions (2015, 2016) surfaced in search; the current-edition jury roster was not located, and press coverage described the jury only as an 'független szakmai zsűri' without naming members.
negative_findings.result_summary: Historical jury registries are retrievable; the current-year jury list is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The jury is a titleholder registry of adjacent industry figures; if the current list is not published, longitudinal jury tracking degrades to a lagging indicator.

negative_findings.description: The Magyar Bankszövetség does not appear to run its own public flagship conference with a published speaker programme; searches in Hungarian returned Portfolio events where the association speaks, not an association-hosted agenda.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association leadership appears on third-party stages rather than its own.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for association officeholders must go through Portfolio agendas plus the association press room, not a conference page.

negative_findings.description: No established Hungarian-language term was found for 'speaker roster / titleholder registry' as an intelligence artefact; the only local handles are the page labels 'Előadók', 'Program' and 'Zsűri'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian discovery must rely on page-label terms plus job-title nouns (igazgató, vezető, vezérigazgató-helyettes, divízióvezető, ügyvezető igazgató).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell should target title nouns and page labels, not concept words, or recall collapses.

negative_findings.description: Speaker announcements on X/Twitter (MNB and organiser accounts) are behind a login wall and covered by anti-scraping ToS.
negative_findings.result_summary: Social-first announcements cannot be collected automatically.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The earliest signal of a speaker/title change is partly unavailable; official websites must be polled more frequently to compensate.

negative_findings.description: No publicly browsable, case-level register of Hungarian collective-redundancy (csoportos létszámleépítés) notifications was found. NFSZ documents the ESTAT electronic filing system and names the receiving kormányhivatal, but the filings themselves appear to be administrative, not published per-employer.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only aggregate statistics and secondary press round-ups (HR Portál) surfaced; no per-bank filing feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The strongest legally-compelled negative signal for this cell is not directly harvestable; collection must rely on aggregates plus press reconstruction, or a freedom-of-information request.

negative_findings.description: Multiple independent Hungarian sources (mfor/Privátbankár survey, money.hu) report that branch-network contraction has NOT been matched by workforce contraction: branches fell from 1401 (start 2025) to 1268 (31 March 2026) while credit-institution employment rose above 40,500.
negative_findings.result_summary: Branch closures and headcount reduction are decoupled in the current Hungarian cycle.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using branch closures as a proxy for layoffs would produce false positives; the cell needs separate indicators for network cuts vs. workforce cuts.

negative_findings.description: The BBDSZ federation web presence (bbdsz.hu) appears dated and the search surface returned mainly historical material (founding congress 1989, general aims) rather than current bargaining or restructuring statements. No current bank-level collective agreement text was located on it.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sectoral federation is identifiable but its site did not yield recent primary documents in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The named union in the seed query may be a weaker live signal than the newer company-level unions (e.g. the UniCredit union under Munkástanácsok). Do not record bbdsz.hu as dead on this evidence — it is unverified.

negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of an active, published, sector-wide collective agreement (ágazati kollektív szerződés) for Hungarian banking, nor of publicly posted works-council (üzemi tanács) minutes at OTP, Erste, K&H or MBH.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic KSZ templates and general legal commentary surfaced; company-level agreement texts were not public.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collective-agreement content for named banks will likely require union contact, leaked/press copies, or FOI — it is not an automatable open source.

negative_findings.description: BBDSZ (Bankok és Biztosítók Dolgozóinak Szakszervezeti Szövetsége) and BDDSZ (bddsz.hu) are near-identical acronyms belonging to different organisations; BRDSZ and VPDSZ also appear in the same result sets and are unrelated public-sector unions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search on the seed acronym returns several unrelated unions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: High risk of misattributing statements to the banking union; the actor map must pin each union by registry ID and domain.

negative_findings.description: The Hungarian phrase 'bankfiók bezárás' is heavily polluted by consumer content about closing a bank ACCOUNT ('bankszámla megszüntetés') and by branch-opening-hours pages; 'leépítés' also returns IT/system decommissioning content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed-style queries return substantial consumer-advice noise.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection queries must be constrained with employer names, 'fiókhálózat', 'hálózatszűkítés', or NFSZ/legal terms to keep precision.

negative_findings.description: No documented free bulk-download or public API for e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu filings was found; the free route appears to be per-company interactive search, with bulk access routed through a paid 'beszámoló állomány értékesítése' licence.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the search page and the ministry's data-sale page were located; no open API endpoint or dataset dump surfaced in hu-language searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sector-wide headcount time series for HU banks and payment institutions will require either paid licensing or per-entity PDF harvesting, which changes the cost and cadence of this workstream.

negative_findings.description: A directly searchable, machine-readable MNB register of granted 'vezető állású személy' személyi engedély decisions per institution was not located in this pass; only the process/guidance pages and PDF engedélyezési útmutatók were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: MNB pages describe the requirement for prior authorisation of senior appointments at payment institutions and financial enterprises, but the searchable decision list was not reached.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MNB approvals are the earliest verifiable signal of a leadership move; without locating the decision register this cell loses its leading indicator and falls back to post-hoc filings.

negative_findings.description: It was not confirmed whether the MNB Aranykönyv per-institution dataset includes an employee-count (létszám) field, or only balance-sheet and income-statement categories.
negative_findings.result_summary: Descriptions of the Aranykönyv mention selected balance-sheet/P&L categories, fund assets and membership data; staff counts were not explicitly mentioned.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Aranykönyv lacks létszám, the only comparable per-institution headcount series remains the filed beszámoló kiegészítő melléklet, making the e-beszámoló route non-optional.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language search result in this pass surfaced an existing published Wayback-diff study or tooling specifically applied to Hungarian bank 'vezetőség' pages; the archive-diff capability must be built in-house.
negative_findings.result_summary: Wayback CDX documentation and generic change-detection tooling were found, but no HU-banking-specific archival monitoring source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's archive/audit role is genuinely unserved by any existing source and must be implemented as a custom collector.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice come from search-result listings; none were individually fetched and confirmed reachable in this pass. One observed result ('e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu/oldal/kereses_merleglista') was labelled a 404 page in results, suggesting some legacy e-beszámoló paths have moved rather than died.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness is unverified by design; the merged pipeline's deterministic verification pass must confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents downstream consumers from treating these as verified-live endpoints and flags that e-beszámoló deep links are unstable and should be re-derived from the search page rather than hard-coded.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian-language searches for a bank-operated shared-service/back-office centre in Szeged ('Szeged szolgáltató központ', 'banki szolgáltató központ bővítés létszám') returned no bank-specific centre. Results were dominated by university service units, generic job boards and unrelated employers.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence located in this run of a foreign-bank GBS/SSC presence in Szeged; the Szeged leg of the cell may be an empty geography rather than an under-covered one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-allocating collection effort to Szeged and flags that Debrecen (BMW BSC, EDC-driven) and Budapest carry nearly all of the cell's signal.

negative_findings.description: Searches for Debrecen-based banking back-office expansion in Hungarian ('Debrecen banki szolgáltató központ bővítés létszám') surfaced only retail branch openings (MBH Bank Debrecen) and a non-bank BSC (BMW). No dedicated foreign-bank service centre in Debrecen was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Debrecen's BSC ecosystem appears to be automotive/industrial-led rather than banking-led so far; banking signal there is currently branch-network, not back-office.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's premise (bank GBS in Debrecen/Szeged) is only partially supported by evidence; monitoring should still run because EDC/HIPA pipelines could change this, but expectations should be calibrated.

negative_findings.description: Erste Hungary's ErStep trainee programme communications were found only on LinkedIn; LinkedIn is behind an authwall and its terms prohibit automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Signal exists but is not lawfully collectable by crawler; requires manual analyst review or licensed data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A significant graduate-pipeline signal for one of Hungary's top-5 banks is structurally unavailable to automated collection.

negative_findings.description: The HOA association's own website domain (hoa.hu) was inferred from the association name and secondary coverage rather than confirmed by a direct search hit; all substantive HOA content encountered was via BBJ, Issuu and SlideShare re-publications.
negative_findings.result_summary: HOA is confirmed to exist and publish annual sector reports, but its canonical URL is a hypothesis pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most valuable pointer source in the cell has an unconfirmed entry point; if wrong, collection must fall back to mirrors.

negative_findings.description: The only Szeged municipal investor page found sits on 'regi.szegedvaros.hu' (regi = legacy/old), indicating a site migration; the current investor section of the Szeged municipality was not located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Legacy archive available; live equivalent unidentified — a 404 or redirect on the current site should not be read as the source being dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risks losing the municipal channel for the Szeged geography entirely if the legacy URL is retired.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, structured public register of university–bank cooperation agreements exists beyond the MNB's own higher-education network page; agreements with commercial banks are announced ad hoc in individual university press rooms.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage of this signal requires N separate university press-room crawls rather than one register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Raises collection cost and creates a real risk of missing agreements at regional universities (Debrecen, Szeged, Pécs, Miskolc) that were not crawled in this run.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian-language searches for a Barion press room ('Barion sajtószoba', 'sajtóközlemény') did not surface any dedicated press/newsroom URL on barion.com. Coverage of Barion appears in third-party media (Portfolio tag page, Index tag page, hvg.hu cégportré) rather than a company-run announcement feed.
negative_findings.result_summary: No barion.com/sajtoszoba or equivalent identified; only careers, about-us and marketing pages plus a LinkedIn/Facebook presence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For the largest HU-owned payment institution, leadership and org news must be picked up from registry data and third-party media rather than a first-party feed, which lowers timeliness and raises verification cost.

negative_findings.description: The cell seed named 'Fintech Group' as a HU payments actor. Hungarian searches returned only a 'FinTech Group Kft.' entry in the Nemzeti Cégtár registry and no corporate site, newsroom, leadership page or press coverage confirming it as an operating payment/e-money employer. Whether the seed refers to that Kft., to a differently named Zrt., or is a mis-seeded actor could not be resolved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only a bare registry record found; no employer-side or media footprint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An unresolved actor either wastes monitoring capacity or hides a real employer. It must be pinned to an MNB-registered legal entity before any collection is configured.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian searches for the MNB list of licensed payment institutions and e-money institutions returned authorisation guidance PDFs (engedélyezési útmutató) rather than a downloadable roster. The register itself lives behind the intezmenykereso.mnb.hu query interface, whose export/API behaviour was not established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register located as an interface; no confirmed bulk/structured export endpoint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Building the authoritative HU payments employer population may require driving a query UI rather than a simple download, which changes the engineering cost of this foundational source.

negative_findings.description: Neither Revolut's HU pages nor Wise's Budapest careers page surfaced a Hungarian-language careers or press channel; both operate in English for recruitment, and no hu-language corporate newsroom for either was found. Hungarian search terms ('iroda', 'állás', 'karrier', 'kinevezés') mostly routed to third-party job boards and media rather than company channels.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign payment/e-money players in HU have essentially no HU-language first-party announcement surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring alone will systematically miss foreign-PSP hiring and leadership signals; English-language and third-party channels are mandatory complements for this half of the cell.

negative_findings.description: No PayU Hungary Hungarian newsroom, leadership page or careers site was identified. PayU HU leadership information came only from third-party interviews (DigitalHungary) and a commercial contact database (RocketReach), and the most specific interview material appears undated/older.
negative_findings.result_summary: PayU HU is visible almost exclusively through intermediated sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Current role-holders at PayU HU cannot be confirmed from first-party sources; any leadership claim about PayU HU needs registry corroboration before use.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language newsroom or press page could be located for Visa's Hungary/CEE country organisation. English queries for a Visa CEE Hungary country-manager announcement returned only travel-visa content and a Budapest job posting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for 'Visa CEE Hungary country manager appointment press release Budapest' returned Schengen visa services, US Embassy visa pages and World Bank country-manager releases; no scheme-related result.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Visa country-manager moves are a core forward indicator for this cell and are currently uncovered; without a source, moves will only be caught indirectly via LinkedIn or conference rosters.

negative_findings.description: The term 'Visa' is severely polluted in both HU and EN search space by travel/Schengen visa content ('vízum' vs 'Visa'), and 'kinevezés'/'appointment' compounds the ambiguity ('vízumidőpont foglalás' = visa appointment booking).
negative_findings.result_summary: Every Visa-scheme query degenerated into consular/visa-application results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection queries for the Visa actor must be constrained (e.g. 'Visa Europe', 'Visa Inc', 'kártyatársaság', co-occurrence with Mastercard/kártyaelfogadás) or they will return near-zero precision.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian-language queries for Euronet Hungary leadership/organisational changes ('Euronet Magyarország ATM vezetőváltás kinevezés hír') produced only consumer fee/ATM articles - no appointment or restructuring coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were Wise/Origo/Kisalföld/biztosdontes consumer pieces plus Euronet's own ATM site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Euronet's Hungarian org changes appear not to be covered in HU media; the register (cégjegyzék) and US IR/SEC disclosure are likely the only reliable channels.

negative_findings.description: Search snippets gave conflicting names for the sitting GIRO Zrt. vezérigazgató (one result implying Oláh Gábor, another Dr. Selmeczi-Kovács Zsolt). Not resolved and not treated as a fact.
negative_findings.result_summary: Aggregated snippets disagreed; no primary page was fetched to adjudicate.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that snippet-level media data is unreliable for this cell and that the official site plus the company register must be the adjudicating sources.

negative_findings.description: No separately branded Hungarian Nexi entity/newsroom was found; Nexi results were Switzerland/Greece/group-level. It is unclear whether Nexi Group has a distinct Hungarian legal entity or serves HU from a regional hub.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries mixing Nexi with Magyarország/Budapest returned only group and other-country pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An actor in the cell brief may not have a local footprint; the actor map should be corrected or the entity located via the company register before allocating collection effort.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian trade publication dedicated specifically to ATM/POS deployment or payment-infrastructure operations was identified; coverage is split between generalist fintech media (FinTechZone) and consumer press.
negative_findings.result_summary: Repeated HU queries surfaced no ATM/POS-industry trade title.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The ATM/POS deployer layer has no dedicated media watchdog in HU, so register-based and career-page monitoring must carry the load.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searching for Bank360.hu A5 content (leadership moves, appointments) returned no matching articles from that domain; results were dominated by Portfolio, Privátbankár and Növekedés instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank360.hu appears to be primarily a product-comparison portal rather than a personnel-news outlet; retained as low-priority candidate, not confirmed as an A5 channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the collection pipeline from spending a scheduled poller on a channel with near-zero A5 recall.

negative_findings.description: Attempted fetch of https://privatbankar.hu/cikkek/karrier returned HTTP 404; the correct section path is https://privatbankar.hu/cikkek/karrier.html (with .html suffix), confirmed via search result titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not a dead source — a path-convention issue. Privátbankár uses .html-suffixed section and tag URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive crawler using extension-less section paths would mark this high-value karrier column as dead.

negative_findings.description: An English-syntax query combining index.hu/telex.hu with 'bank vezérigazgató kinevezés 2026' returned mostly irrelevant EU-document PDFs; the same outlets surfaced correctly only when reached via hu-language snowballing from other queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site-scoped queries against Hungarian general-news domains are unreliable through this search interface; section crawling / RSS is the dependable route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Discovery strategy for Index and Telex must be crawl-based, not search-based, or coverage will be silently incomplete.

negative_findings.description: Per-section RSS endpoints were only inferred from the Portfolio RSS index page description; individual feed URLs (e.g. a bank-section XML) were not independently confirmed in this pass, and RSS availability for Privátbankár, vg.hu, Növekedés, HRPWR, FinTechRadar and FinTechZone was not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: Feed-level access is a hypothesis pending the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection method choice (RSS poller vs HTML crawler) per source is still open for most of the cell.

negative_findings.description: Portfolio.hu and HVG.hu both operate partial subscription models (Portfolio Signature / hvg360); some in-depth leadership and restructuring pieces are likely subscriber-only. Extent not measured in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Headline-level A5 signal appears to remain free; detail may be gated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects whether entity-level extraction (names, dates, remits) is possible without a paid subscription.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searching of Finextra for Hungarian banking/payments appointments returned only non-Hungarian items (Brite, Standard Chartered, FCA, Versapay, Stax). No Hungary-specific personnel article surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Finextra is a valid channel by structure but has near-zero observed Hungary personnel yield; keep it as a keyword tripwire, not a primary feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting a globally prominent trade outlet that in practice does not cover the Hungarian market's personnel layer.

negative_findings.description: Searches aimed at The Paypers for Hungarian payments appointments returned nothing from thepaypers.com; results drifted to UK 'Payments Association' CEO news and PayPal. The Paypers' Hungary personnel coverage could not be evidenced in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No thepaypers.com Hungary appointment item found; the outlet remains a plausible but unevidenced channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A seed query assumption did not hold; the cell's payments-press coverage rests mainly on scheme newsrooms and FinTech Futures instead.

negative_findings.description: No PaymentsSource/American Banker item on Hungarian personnel was surfaced, and no dedicated Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com) article on Hungarian banking appointments appeared despite a targeted query.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two named seed outlets produced zero Hungary personnel evidence in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These should be revisited with entity-specific queries (OTP, MBH, K&H, Erste Hungary, Raiffeisen Hungary) before being written off.

negative_findings.description: A Hungarian-language control query ('kinevezés vezérigazgató bank ... sajtóközlemény Erste Raiffeisen UniCredit') returned rich HU-only coverage (Portfolio.hu on the new Raiffeisen CEO and accompanying personnel changes, azenpenzem.hu, n4b.hu press-release wire, Erste Bank HU sajtóközlemények, Magyar Bankszövetség governing bodies page) with no matching English releases from the same groups.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian-owned/HU-subsidiary appointment news is systematically published in HU first and often only in HU; the English layer covers it partially and later.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms this English cell cannot stand alone — it must be paired with the hu-press cell, and English-only monitoring will miss or delay a large share of Hungarian bank personnel events.

negative_findings.description: The two highest-credibility international wires in this cell (Bloomberg, Reuters) are paywalled and bot-defended; their Hungary personnel items were only visible as headlines or via syndication mirrors (MarketScreener, Investing.com).
negative_findings.result_summary: Wire content is reachable in principle but not freely collectible; treat as unverified-but-live and route via licensed access or mirrors.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must budget for licensing or accept mirror-based, delayed and partial capture of the fastest-breaking items.

negative_findings.description: Every core source in this cell (LinkedIn company pages, people tabs, content search, personal profiles; X timelines; Facebook pages) sits behind an authentication wall and platform ToS that prohibit automated scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: No unauthenticated, ToS-clean bulk feed exists for the highest-value sources in this cell. Search-engine indexing of public LinkedIn posts is the only login-free partial window found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design for A5 cannot assume crawlability; it must budget for analyst time, in-product saved searches/alerts, or a licensed data product (LinkedIn Talent Insights / Sales Navigator).

negative_findings.description: No LinkedIn company-page slug for OTP Mobil / SimplePay, Gránit Bank, CIB Bank, UniCredit Bank Hungary or Revolut Hungary was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only OTP Bank, MBH Bank, K&H Csoport, Erste Magyarország, Raiffeisen Bank Hungary, Barion and FinTechZone slugs were observed in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments side of the actor map is under-covered relative to the banking side; several major payments and challenger actors have no confirmed handle yet.

negative_findings.description: X/Twitter is a thin channel for Hungarian banking personnel news; the corporate accounts found are low-volume and Facebook is used mainly for consumer marketing rather than appointments.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one Hungarian bank corporate X handle (@otpbank_hu) was confirmed; MNB's Facebook page was the only social account observed actually carrying a leadership-transition post.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Effort in this cell should be weighted heavily toward LinkedIn; X/Facebook are confirmation channels, not discovery channels.

negative_findings.description: The Hungarian idiom query around 'csatlakoztam' returned ecosystem articles rather than individual announcement posts.
negative_findings.result_summary: Open-web search on 'csatlakoztam' + fintech surfaced portals (fintech.hu, FinTechZone, hunfintech.com) but no direct self-announcement posts, unlike 'örömmel osztom meg' which did.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Idiom selection materially changes yield; the phrase list must be tuned empirically rather than assumed, and 'örömmel osztom meg' should be the anchor phrase.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or confirmed reachable; all entries are search-result-derived.
negative_findings.result_summary: Candidates are recorded with confidence scores only; the OTP Mobil slug in particular is an explicit hypothesis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream liveness verification must run before any of these are promoted to a monitored watchlist.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Erste Bank Hungary career portal URL was surfaced in either hu or en searches; only aggregator pages (Indeed) listing Erste Hungary roles appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Erste HU vacancy feed currently only reachable indirectly; the group-level Erste careers site was not confirmed for the HU entity in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Erste is a top-5 HU bank; missing its primary feed leaves a hole in the demand signal for one of the largest payment/digital programmes in the market.

negative_findings.description: No CIB Bank (Intesa Sanpaolo HU) career page was returned despite an explicit hu query naming CIB.
negative_findings.result_summary: CIB career/ATS URL unresolved in this slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CIB is a significant HU bank; its hiring is invisible to the collector until the portal is located.

negative_findings.description: Hungarian payment-fintech employers Barion, OTP Mobil (Simple), PayPal-adjacent and acquirer/PSP vendors returned no career-page hits in the hu query used.
negative_findings.result_summary: PSP/fintech-side career pages not yet mapped; only bank-side portals resolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSPs and acquirers are exactly where instant-payment / qvik / SoftPOS engineering demand shows up first; the cell is currently bank-heavy.

negative_findings.description: Search results state Jobline.hu ceases operation on 31 January 2026 and the site will become inaccessible. Not independently fetched; treated as unverified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Jobline recorded as at-risk/likely-retired rather than dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If true, a 25-year HU vacancy archive disappears; historical baselines should be captured from web archives before relying on it.

negative_findings.description: Indeed.hu and LinkedIn Jobs dominate HU result pages but are anti-bot / auth-walled respectively; no direct fetch was attempted, so their state is a hypothesis not a verdict.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two highest-volume aggregators are collectable only manually or under licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated volume tracking must rest on Profession/CVonline/own-ATS feeds instead; aggregator counts can only be used as occasional spot-checks.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language vocabulary was established for Workday tenant naming, so Workday-hosted HU bank career sites (myworkdayjobs.com tenants) could not be located by hu-language search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Workday tenant inventory for HU financial employers is empty.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Several foreign-owned banks route HU vacancies through group Workday tenants; without the tenant list those roles are missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: Michael Page / PageGroup appears to have no Hungarian office. Search of PageGroup's own Europe locations material indicates the CEE market including Hungary is served from Vienna.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Budapest PageGroup office found; only global/regional salary guides and a Vienna-run CEE coverage model.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query assumed a Michael Page Hungary presence. Any HU banking salary data from Michael Page is regional extrapolation, not local primary research, and should be down-weighted accordingly.

negative_findings.description: No Boyden Hungary / Boyden Budapest office or Hungarian-language Boyden content surfaced in either hu or en searches, despite Boyden being named in the cell definition.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'Amrop Boyden Budapest executive search' and the Hungarian 'fejvadász bankszektor vezetői kinevezés' returned Amrop, Beck & Partners, HumanField and HR Portál — never Boyden.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief may over-specify the actor list. Boyden should be treated as unconfirmed in HU until a dedicated check of boyden.com office listings is done; substitute Stanton Chase, Horton International, Cornerstone and Friisberg as the confirmed international-network nodes.

negative_findings.description: No banking/payments-specific salary or hiring report published by a recruiter for Hungary was found. Finance appears only as a chapter or sector cut inside general HU salary guides (Hays) or general employment surveys (Manpower MEOS).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in hu for 'bérriport bankszektor', 'munkaerőpiaci jelentés pénzügy' returned only cross-sector products; the finance signal is always a sub-slice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be designed to extract the finance/insurance sub-slice from cross-sector documents rather than expecting a standalone banking hiring report. It also means no HU recruiter currently publishes payments-specific (PSP, acquiring, card-scheme) role data — a genuine market data void.

negative_findings.description: Trenkwalder's flagship recurring HU product (the quarterly wage barometer) covers blue-collar hourly wages, not financial-services white-collar roles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every retrieved Trenkwalder 2026 item concerned skilled/semi-skilled physical workers' gross hourly rates; no banking or finance cut appeared.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query implied Trenkwalder as a finance labour-market source. It should be reclassified as macro labour-cost context, and the collection budget reallocated to Hays, Manpower MEOS and the executive-search mandate boards.

negative_findings.description: No current (2025/2026) Grafton Hungary Salary & Market Guide URL surfaced; only a 2017 PDF on an apparently legacy subdomain and an Issuu-hosted joint business-services guide co-authored with Hays and Trenkwalder.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned 25.grafton.hu 2017 PDF and an issuu.com business-services guide; nothing dated 2025-2026.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Grafton may have folded its HU guide into Gi Group Holding branding or discontinued it. This is a hypothesis, not a verdict — a manual visit to grafton.hu / gigroupholding.com HU pages is required before recording it as discontinued.

negative_findings.description: ISG International Executive Consulting Kft. and Kienbaum Executive Consultants Kft. are both named in the BBJ/HR Portál Hungarian executive-search revenue ranking, but no Hungarian-domain URL for either was returned by search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor names confirmed via ranking coverage; their HU web presences were not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two ranked, revenue-significant HU search firms are in the actor map but not yet in the source map. Resolving their domains is a cheap, high-yield next step.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated SZÉP-card issuers' association or 'Magyar Utalványkibocsátók Egyesülete' could be located. Hungarian searches surfaced only issuer product pages (OTP, K&H, MBH) and the BFKH/MKEH regulatory register of SZÉP-card acceptance, plus the rule that since 2018 only payment service providers may issue SZÉP cards.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's seed assumption of a 'Magyar SZÉP/kártyaszövetség' is not supported by evidence; the issuer set appears to be governed via MNB/BFKH registers and the Bankszövetség rather than a standalone trade body.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated association entry and redirects SZÉP/benefit-card entity discovery to the BFKH register and to bank issuer newsrooms (cell overlap with registry/regulator cells).

negative_findings.description: AmCham Hungary's Financial Services / banking committee chairperson was not identifiable from public search. The board of directors is published with names and companies, but committee leadership was not exposed in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Board-level leadership is trackable; committee-level FS leadership is not, from search alone.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Committee chairs are exactly the mid-senior FS names A5 wants; a direct crawl of amcham.hu committee pages (or the member magazine) is needed rather than search-engine discovery.

negative_findings.description: No distinct Hungarian association was found for savings cooperatives ('takarékszövetkezetek') as a live body — the sector consolidated into MBH Bank, so the historic OTSZ/Takarékbank interest-representation layer appears defunct.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on 'takarékszövetkezetek elnök megválasztás tagok' returned no current association; only MABISZ and leasing results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids scheduling collection against a body that likely no longer exists; historic references in older documents should be resolved to MBH Bank.

negative_findings.description: The Blockchain Koalíció (formed 8 March 2022 by the innovation ministry and the national data-economy knowledge centre) has no standalone portal discoverable via search; only trade-press interviews name its chair.
negative_findings.result_summary: Quasi-official body reachable only indirectly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Its membership would enumerate DLT/payments actors with state ties; the absence of a primary source caps confidence in anything attributed to it.

negative_findings.description: None of the core association sites (bankszovetseg.hu, hunfintech.com, lizingszovetseg.hu, hblf.hu) advertised an RSS/Atom feed or an API in what was observed; bankszovetseg.hu and hblf.hu use legacy query-string CMS URLs (.cshtml?lang=hun, index.php?searchenginerUrl=...).
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection must be HTML scraping with diffing, not feed subscription; deep links are fragile.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic engineering expectations and warns that stored deep links will rot — crawls should re-resolve from site roots.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer-owned careers/ATS endpoints missing for eight of the nine banks in the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated hu-language careers sweep per issuer using terms 'karrier', 'állás', 'nyitott pozíciók', 'csatlakozz hozzánk', 'karrieroldal' scoped to each bank domain; also probe the common ATS vendors HU banks use (SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Talentcloud, Nexum) by searching for '<bank> + jelentkezés + karrier'.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign-parent IR/press rooms (KBC, Erste Group, RBI, UniCredit SpA, Intesa Sanpaolo) are the true origin layer for HU-subsidiary board changes but are not clearly inside this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Explicitly assign parent-group IR/newsrooms to this cell or to a named neighbouring cell, and add group-level 'management changes' pages for the five foreign parents so HU subsidiary appointments are not missed.

coverage_gaps.description: The nine named banks are not the full HU systemic issuer set; state-owned and specialist institutions (MFB, Eximbank, Takarékbank legacy entities, Magyar Posta/ MBH-adjacent entities, Oberbank HU, Cetelem, Sberbank successor perimeter) were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full Magyar Bankszövetség member list by iterating tagId on bankszovetseg.hu and reconcile against the MNB institution register, then decide which additional issuers merit a press-room watch.

coverage_gaps.description: Issuer-owned social channels (LinkedIn company pages, YouTube, Facebook) were not scouted, although banks announce appointments and hiring campaigns there first and in Hungarian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the official LinkedIn/Facebook pages of each of the nine banks, but flag them as ToS-restricted: LinkedIn scraping is prohibited, so plan for manual or licensed access only.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom/JSON feed was confirmed for any of the nine press rooms; all collection plans currently assume HTML/PDF scraping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each press room, probe for /rss, /feed, sitemap.xml and the CMS's native feed endpoint (K&H appears to run Liferay, UniCredit an AEM /content/dam structure, MBH a custom /sw/static store) and record robots.txt constraints per domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of each press room (how far back the index paginates) is unknown, so no baseline period for leadership-move rates can be set.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each press room, probe the deepest reachable page/year and record the earliest item date; use the CIB net.cib.hu year-indexed archive as the model for backfill where issuers keep legacy hosts.

coverage_gaps.description: I could not exercise the actual query mechanics of the three core event sources (MNB határozatok és végzések keresése, cegkozlony.hu/kereses, kozzetetelek.mnb.hu lekérdező) — parameter names, pagination, date filtering, rate limits and anti-bot behaviour are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a hands-on technical probe (browser automation + network capture) against each of the three search endpoints to capture request payloads and build stable collectors; document per-endpoint rate limits.

coverage_gaps.description: No crosswalk was found between MNB institution identifiers (Intézménykereső registration numbers) and cégjegyzékszám / adószám, which is required to join regulator decisions to company-register officer events.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the crosswalk manually for the ~100-entity HU banking/payments watchlist from Intézménykereső records plus e-cégjegyzék lookups; store as the canonical entity table for all A5 cells.

coverage_gaps.description: Savings cooperatives, small pénzügyi vállalkozások, PSD2 payment/e-money institutions and independent intermediaries are inside the statutory regime but were not individually enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full Intézménykereső population per sector category and the Közvetítők keresése register, then apply the same Cégközlöny/e-cégjegyzék officer-diff pipeline uniformly.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level registers that mirror or supplement HU officeholder/entity data (EBA credit institutions register, ESMA registers, SSM/ECB fit-and-proper for significant institutions such as OTP) were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up probe of EBA/ESMA/ECB registers for HU-domiciled institutions; ECB fit-and-proper applies to significant institutions and may publish or imply senior-appointment approvals not visible on mnb.hu.

coverage_gaps.description: The publication lag between an actual appointment, the MNB decision, the Cégközlöny entry and the e-cégjegyzék refresh has not been measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Backtest 10-20 known 2024-2026 HU bank executive changes across all four sources and measure per-source latency, to decide which source is the trigger and which are the confirmations.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell's regulatory/statutory sources cover officeholders well but carry almost no signal on the 'jobs / hiring' topic (vacancy volumes, headcount trends) beyond annual headcount in e-beszámoló filings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on other A5 cells (job boards, career sites, KSH labour statistics) for hiring volume; use e-beszámoló 'átlagos statisztikai létszám' from this cell as the annual authoritative anchor for validating them.

coverage_gaps.description: Reuse and redistribution rights differ sharply across sources: MNB/Cégközlöny/e-beszámoló are free public-sector information, while OCCSZ extracts and OPTEN/Céginfo data are licensed products, and all officer data is personal data under GDPR.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain a written legal position on (a) storing named-person officer histories for internal market intelligence and (b) the redistribution terms of each paid register product, before operationalising the pipeline.

coverage_gaps.description: State-influenced (rather than state-owned) financial actors — e.g. banks with state or state-linked shareholding, Gránit/MBH-type structures, KAVOSZ/Széchenyi Kártya programme operators, Posta Biztosító — were not systematically enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the ownership map from MNV Zrt. portfolio data and Corvinus/holding-vehicle disclosures, then extend the Cégközlöny watchlist to those entities.

coverage_gaps.description: Only TED has a confirmed documented API/bulk-download route. Magyar Közlöny, Hivatalos Értesítő, Cégközlöny, EKR and KÖZIGÁLLÁS have no API confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical probe for RSS feeds, sitemap.xml, and stable URL patterns on each Hungarian portal; where absent, budget for HTML/PDF scraping with change-detection.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's pointer role — mining procurement awards for supplier names serving state financial bodies — was identified but not exercised; no award-notice supplier extraction was performed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a TED + Közbeszerzési Értesítő award-notice sweep for HU state financial buyers over the last 24 months, CPV 72/79, and emit the supplier list as new actor candidates for other cells.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin by nature: only TED and entity English pages publish in English; gazette and company-register material is Hungarian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Accept Hungarian as the working language for this cell and budget for hu-language NER/normalisation of person and unit names rather than relying on English mirrors.

coverage_gaps.description: No assessment was made of how far back each portal's archive reaches (gazette archives, Cégközlöny back-issues, TED pre-2011 bulk).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe archive depth per source before backfill planning; TED bulk monthly collections are documented from January 2011.

coverage_gaps.description: No source found covering the big global SI/outsourcing layer in Hungary (IBM, T-Systems Hungary, Accenture, DXC, Deloitte/EY technology arms), which typically staffs the largest private-bank programmes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated HU sweep on 'rendszerintegrátor bank', 'kiszervezés banki IT', plus each SI's Hungarian careers site, to add integrator hiring pages to the watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: Domestic banking-software vendors beyond Finshape were not covered: Dorsum, Cellum, Microsec, NetLock, Scriptum, R34DY, Sysdata and similar.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball each from the MINDSPIRE blog and IVSZ (HU ICT association) membership list; add their news and careers pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-run and trade-run conference agendas (CIO Hungary, Portfolio Banking Technology / Hitelezés, IT Business events) were identified only in passing, not catalogued.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Catalogue the annual HU banking-technology conference agenda pages as a standing source — speaker lists are the densest public directory of bank IT/ops leadership titles in this market.

coverage_gaps.description: Foreign vendors (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Thales, IDEMIA, Nexi) publish nothing in Hungarian, so no local-language terms exist for their HU appointments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For these vendors substitute registry-based officer diffing (nemzeticegtar/ceginfo) plus HU trade-press mentions, and accept that local-language search will not reach them.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival/indirect-reveal channel established for vendor pages that get quietly edited (customer-logo walls, leadership pages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route the vendor watchlist through a snapshotting layer (own snapshots or Wayback CDX queries) so removed bank logos and replaced country-lead bios become detectable events.

coverage_gaps.description: State-adjacent procurement visibility for bank-serving vendors was not explored, despite 4iG's state framework contracts being under review.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check Közbeszerzési Értesítő / EKR for the same vendor entities — even if private banks never appear, award notices reveal vendor capacity, staffing and delivery-unit structure.

coverage_gaps.description: Past-edition speaker pages are the core value of this cell (title drift between editions), but several organisers rewrite or retire event URLs; no snapshot layer is in place.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every roster crawl with a Wayback Machine snapshot lookup and store our own dated HTML copies so title-drift diffs survive site rewrites.

coverage_gaps.description: Current-year jury and speaker rosters for Év Bankja and for TechShow X 2026 were not directly confirmed page-by-page in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted fetch of evbankja.hu jury/current-edition paths and the TechShow X speaker page once the 2026 agenda is published (Jun–Oct 2026).

coverage_gaps.description: Insurance-adjacent and savings-cooperative/neobank events, and vendor-hosted client days (core-banking and card-processing suppliers), were not enumerated; these carry mid-level operations and IT titles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a discovery sweep over vendor client-day and insurance conference agendas, filtering speakers by financial-institution employer.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian job titles vary in wording across organisers for the same role, and English event pages give different renderings; no normalisation dictionary exists yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a hu→en title normalisation table (vezérigazgató, vezérigazgató-helyettes, ügyvezető igazgató, divízióvezető, igazgatóságvezető, területi igazgató, szakmai vezető) so title drift is measured on normalised roles, not raw strings.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the Mastercard Év Bankja programme was mapped; other Hungarian financial awards and shortlists (marketing, IT, employer-brand, insurance awards) that also publish juries and named entrants were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'díj', 'pályázat', 'zsűri', 'shortlist' plus finance keywords to enumerate secondary award registries.

coverage_gaps.description: Case-level collective-redundancy notifications filed via ESTAT to county/Budapest government offices are not open data.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: File a kozerdeku adatigenyles (FOI request) with NFSZ or the Budapest Fővárosi Kormányhivatal for anonymised/sectoral breakdowns of NACE-K collective redundancy notifications; test whether any kormanyhivatal publishes them locally.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the UniCredit Bank Hungary company union was clearly identified as a live, active company-level union in banking. Equivalent bodies at OTP, MBH, Erste, K&H, Raiffeisen, CIB and Gránit were not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball from the Munkástanácsok / LIGA / MASZSZ affiliate lists and the szakszervezetek.hu union database; cross-check each against the civil-organisation registry (birosag.hu civil szervezetek névjegyzéke).

coverage_gaps.description: The official Hungarian civil-organisation registry (birosag.hu civil szervezetek névjegyzéke) and the official company register (e-cegjegyzek / Cégközlöny) were not directly searched in this pass; only the commercial aggregator Céginfo was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated probe of birosag.hu and e-cegjegyzek/Cégközlöny for finance-sector unions and for bank entity mergers/branch deregistrations.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual reports / e-beszámoló filings of individual Hungarian banks, which carry audited average headcount figures, were not probed; only MBH's disclosure page and bond prospectus were reached.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu and each bank's investor-relations page for per-entity average staff numbers; build a per-bank annual headcount series to detect quiet contraction.

coverage_gaps.description: No source of Hungarian labour-court decisions (birosag.hu anonimizált határozatok) was assessed, although the UniCredit union-president dismissal is explicitly heading to court.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the anonymised court decision collection as a candidate source and set a watch on finance-sector labour disputes.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of Hungarian bank workforce contraction is thin and mostly routed through Eurofound ERM; no Hungarian-focused English trade outlet (e.g. BBJ, Telex English) was confirmed as a systematic source.
